instructions_en.title: How to Complete SCC Log Notes
steps: This form documents daily activities provided through Supported Community Connections (SCC) services. Complete one entry for each service session.
⚠️ Important: Date/Times MUST match the timesheet submitted. Any discrepancy will not be billed/paid to the independent contractor. Please submit your notes and timesheet on the 20th of each month.
Person Receiving Services Name: Enter the full name of the individual.
IP Goal: Enter the relevant Individual Plan goal being addressed.

instructions_en.title: Activity Documentation
steps: Choices of Activities Offered: List all activity options you presented to the individual
Specific Location and Activity Selected: Document where you went and what activity the person chose

instructions_en.title: Purpose/Goal (Check all that apply)
steps: Development of Natural Supports in the Community
Development or introduction to new skill

instructions_en.title: Detailed Explanation
steps: What is the purpose, or the goal of the activity? Check off the opportunities that the activity provided. Use the explanation area to detail:
DO NOT use: "Good day, bad day, etc."
Be specific and objective in your observations

instructions_en.title: Community Connections
steps: Who did individual connect with in the community? Were prompts needed?
Indicate level of support: Verbal, Physical, or Independent

instructions_en.title: Successes and Support Needs
steps: Discuss Successes and/or areas where additional support may be needed:

instructions_en.title: Goal Implementation
steps: Document how the goal was implemented today:
If you provided a second service session on the same day or a different day, complete Entry #2 with the same level of detail as Entry #1.
Deadline: Submit notes and timesheet by the 20th of each month.
How did today's activity relate to the IP goal?
What specific actions supported goal progress?
SCC Provider Signature: Enter your name to certify these notes
Review all entries for accuracy and completeness
